label: Whatever is in potency in no respect operates from itself. q.18 a.3 ad…, by Disjunctive syllogism…
rule: Disjunctive syllogism, existential elimination, proof by cases, reductio
meaning: Whatever is in potency in no respect operates from itself. A pure act is not in potency in its being, so by the OPEN act/potency division it is in act in being; by the OPEN premise that operation follows being in act it has an operation; by the OPEN dichotomy the operation is from itself or the thing is being moved in some respect; and the second case is excluded by the existing stated q.2 a.3 reading (nothing is moved except as in potency) since a pure act has no potency.
